data.sub: Police ne judge ke badle Owaisi ko Guard of Honor de diya

chat.say: VIP gaadi aayi, humne salute thonk diya!
Bhai pehle chehra to dekh lete!

data.asar: Jaldi baazi mein aisi hi gadbad ho jati hai!
data.caption:
Saharanpur mein UP Police se ho gayi aisi chuk jo ab internet par viral ho rahi hai! 😂👮‍♂️

• Supreme Court ke judge ke aane par Guard of Honor dene ki taiyari thi
• Circuit house par judge se pehle Asaduddin Owaisi pahunch gaye
• Police ne confusion mein Owaisi ko hi Guard of Honor pesh kar diya
• Mamle ka video samne aane ke baad ab janch ke aadesh diye gaye hain

VIP gaadi aate hi bina chehra dekhe full protocol on ho gaya! 

Dost ko tag karo jo bina soche-samjhe aisi hi gadbad karta hai! 👇
